entities.name: T. Sirasapalli Naval Systems Manufacturing Facility

operating_notes.text: BDL, as Development-cum-Production Partner with DRDO's NSTL, delivered the first indigenous production-grade Wire Guided Heavy Weight Torpedo at its Visakhapatnam unit on 23 April 2026.

New ~160-acre naval systems facility at T. Sirasapalli, Anakapalli district, AP, with ~₹500 Cr estimated investment and completion expected in about four years; to focus on underwater weapon systems, torpedoes and mines.
FY26 inventories include ₹83.27 Cr of stock non-moving for more than five years, against which ₹362.34 Cr of advances were received on short-closed contracts, so no redundancy provision was made.
FY26 other income of ₹423.77 Cr included interest income of ₹311.94 Cr, against ₹299.90 Cr in FY25.
The company has invested in Electronic Warfare (Defence) Testing Foundation and Advanced Materials (Defence) Testing Foundation, Section 8 not-for-profit associates not consolidated.

BSE and NSE each fined BDL ₹6,96,200 (GST inclusive) for the quarter ended 31 March 2026 under SEBI LODR Regulations 17(1), 18 and 19; BDL will seek a waiver on grounds of impossibility of compliance as director appointments vest with the P
Order book was ₹26,176 Cr as on 31 March 2026, with ₹15,000 Cr of new orders received in FY26 and ₹5,909 Cr of orders in the pipeline.
Export order position was ₹417 Cr as on 31 March 2026.
R&D expenditure was ₹198.23 Cr, 8.1% of sales, in FY26, against ₹222.92 Cr (6.7%) in FY25.
BDL signed a contract with the Indian Navy for supply of heavyweight torpedoes valued at approximately ₹1,307 Cr plus taxes, to be completed within 42 months.

timeline.summary: On 23 April 2026, BDL delivered India's first indigenous production-grade Wire Guided Heavy Weight Torpedo to NSTL at its Visakhapatnam unit as Development-cum-Production Partner.

On 15 May 2026, the Raksha Mantri laid the foundation stone for BDL's new naval systems manufacturing facility at T. Sirasapalli, Andhra Pradesh, a ~160-acre, ~₹500 Cr project expected to be completed in about four years.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹480.2 Cr (-73.0% YoY), net profit ₹113.18 Cr (-58.5% YoY).

On 29 May 2026, BDL disclosed that BSE and NSE each fined it ₹6,96,200 (GST inclusive) for the quarter ended 31 March 2026 for non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulations 17(1), 18 and 19, and said it would seek a waiver as director appointments rest with the President of India through the Ministry of Defence.
On 15 October 2026, BDL signed a contract with the Indian Navy for supply of heavyweight torpedoes valued at approximately ₹1,307 Cr plus taxes, to be completed within 42 months.
